name: Zhang Xuanshi
introduction: I study software engineering at Zhejiang University’s College of Computer Science and Technology and minor in the Intensive Training Program for Innovation and Entrepreneurship Management (ITP) at Chu Kochen Honors College.

I’m a serial entrepreneur and musician. I’ve started ventures, worked on projects and competed across several fields. My current focus is exploring new forms for AI hardware and how people interact with it.
Little Stone Still Here is where I keep what I learn, what I make and bits of everyday life. I hope these things give you a sense of who I am.

learning: I am learning mechatronics, embedded systems and mechanical design to better understand software–hardware tradeoffs and turn product ideas into testable prototypes.
life: I love Pink Floyd and things that feel psychedelic, expansive and gentle. I play bass and erhu, sing and arrange music. As a regular band member in the university electric music ensemble, I have played at music festivals on and off campus.
Away from the screen, I swim and enjoy ball sports. Making things, listening to music and volunteering are all parts of my everyday life.
